verdict.rationale: Datadog has a first-party, documented official MCP server (docs.datadoghq.com/mcp_server/), and a probe confirmed it, so AI agents can connect to Datadog through it. The evidence shows only that the page exists, not what it contains, so depth is thin. Missing for 10: details on exposed tools, auth and client setup, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
